subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native `runtime="subagent"` support parent-visible progress through `streamTo="parent"`, and what redaction/default-visibility contract should govern those child events?
rationale: The request crosses session and channel visibility boundaries, and child progress can contain sensitive tool inputs, command output, paths, patches, or reasoning-like content; code alone cannot choose the product/security default.

options.title: Define Redacted Native Stream
options.body: Add native parent progress only as a bounded projection with raw tool inputs/results and thinking hidden by default, plus tests and docs for the security boundary.

options.title: Keep ACP-Only StreamTo
options.body: Leave native subagents on completion events and status surfaces, documenting that `streamTo` remains an ACP runtime feature.

options.title: Add Minimal Status Heartbeats
options.body: Expose only start/still-running/done notices for native subagents, deferring detailed child output visibility to a separate design.

recommendation.title: Define Redacted Native Stream
recommendation.body: Add native parent progress only as a bounded projection with raw tool inputs/results and thinking hidden by default, plus tests and docs for the security boundary.
